oracleRisk.summary: Exact oracle topology traced at Ethereum block 26114891: PT-reUSD uses the minimum of a 900-second Pendle TWAP and a fixed linear-discount price; PT-sUSDS uses the same Ojo minimum behind a deviation-timelock selector; PT-sUSDE uses a fixed linear-discount primary behind that selector. Backup paths share the PT pricing leg and add an underlying Chainlink/USD leg with a constant-one USDC quote. No independent live USDC depeg feed is selected. These are known synthetic/single-market pricing paths, not independently redundant dollar feeds. Share NAV remains internal accounting; funded liquidation recovery is not established.

branchApplicability.rationale: ERC-4626 accounting is not a borrower-oracle exemption. The current adapter exposes USDC loans secured by oracle-valued collateral, with separate liquidation branches.

branches.label: PT-reUSD-10DEC2026 / USDC
branches.summary: Block 26114891 reconfirmed the exact market oracle 0x217d6ddcdb95112c51657f6270e8c079cfdb51f0. Its only nonzero pricing input is OjoPTFeed 0x77ee147391eac11c92817e771860ff4aad265d89, an immutable clone of 0x5aab95e3c6f9ba0ccfa0a17c2c7235633c7c6585. Ojo selects the lower of the 900-second Pendle TWAP at 0x570ea68f11e63a9108514eb73dc4f88232c9e7f6 and a 6%-annualized fixed linear-discount feed at 0x8e42d93eac7dfef8d061dd18a2acfc839e724309 through timestamp adapter 0x7cfd3ed001d9d65d4022db4e15c6101db2bbc994. The adapter replaces updatedAt with block.timestamp; this is not proof of external feed freshness. USDC is assumed one, not externally priced.

feeds.provider: Verified MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 with one Ojo synthetic-price leg
Ojo minimum of 900-second Pendle TWAP and synthetic linear discount

branches.fallbackBehavior: No alternate root price source: Ojo calls both feeds and chooses the minimum. Its 24-hour stale check applies only to nonzero updatedAt; the linear feed is wrapped to stamp current block time. A failed feed call reverts Ojo. The outer Morpho oracle checks positive answers but does not enforce updatedAt. No live USDC/USD feed is selected.

collateralParameters.note: Immutable market liquidation loan-to-value from Morpho API, not vault utilization or a liquidation execution guarantee.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any external liquidator may repay debt and receive collateral when oracle-valued LTV exceeds LLTV. Actual callability and stressed sale execution on this exact feed were not measured.
branches.backstop: The reviewed code/documentation establishes permissionless incentivized liquidation; no funded exact-market recovery backstop was established.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Morpho losses reduce the adapter claim; VaultV2 accrual realizes reduced realAssets as proportional share-price depreciation. No exact-market funded shutdown recovery or legal priority is established.

Correlated backup is not independent PT or USDC price discovery.
